To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Xcv suppresses sugar-mediated plant defense responses by interfering with cw-Inv expression and activity, and that XopB is the Xcv T3SS effector responsible for this activity.

1) Xcv T3ES suppress cw-Inv expression during infection, 2) XopB is one of these Xcv T3SS effectors that inhibits cw-Inv activity and 3) XopB-mediated suppression of cw-Inv is required to prevent sugar-induced defense responses during Xanthomonas infection.
Xcv suppress cw-Inv expression in a T3ES-dependent manner and that Xcv T3ES XopB is involved in the suppression of this defense response.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the regulation of cw-Inv in Xcv-infected pepper leaves by T3Es.
the role of Xcv T3ES in the regulation of cw-Inv during infection.
the regulation of cw-Inv in pepper plants during Xcv infection and with the identification of Xcv T3 Es that suppress cw-Inv.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the T3E XopB is involved in the regulation of cw-Inv during infection with Xcv and thereby in the modulation of plant defense responses.
Xcv T3SS effector XopB suppresses cw-INV activity in pepper, which is likely to contribute to the pathogenicity of Xcv.
XopB is an effector protein that suppresses cw- Inv activity in pepper plants.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
XopB suppresses cw- Inv activity in pepper leaves to facilitate bacterial propagation.
Xcv T3ES, and especially XopB, interfere with plant defense responses by suppressing cw-Inv activity to prevent sugar-mediated induction of plant defenses.
the Xcv T3SS suppresses cw- Inv activity in planta to facilitate infection.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the XopB protein of Xanthomonas is a virulence effector that interferes with cell wall invertase activity.
XopB, a Xanthomonas type 3 effctor protein, suppresses cell wall-bound invertse activity in pepper leaves.
T3E proteins can suppress the activity of a cell wall-bound invertse to prevent sugar-enhanced defense.
